}}'''Sandip''' is a [[Lieutenant]] with the [[Band of the Red Hand]]. He appears to work primarily with the scouts. He is also an accomplished hedge-doctor.

== Appearance ==
He is tan-skinned and dark haired.

==Activities==
Sandip is involved in the [[Last Battle#The Andoran front|Andoran front of the Last Battle]] with the rest of the Band, trying to rescue the fleeing citizens and recover the [[dragons]] before they can be captured by [[Shadowspawn]].

== Trivia ==
* Sandip is named for Sandip Mehta, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
